message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal public holidays that create “long weekends” in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you’re planning for a specific province, you’ll want to add the provincial holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday – see the notes at the bottom.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Jan 1–2** (Sun‑Mon) | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, BC, AB, NB, PE) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Mon) | Not a federal holiday; provincial only |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sun) | |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Mon) | |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jul 1–3** (Sat‑Mon) | Observed on Monday, Jul 3 |
| **Civic Holiday** (most provinces) | Aug 5 | Monday | **Aug 3–5** (Sat‑Mon) | Not a federal holiday; provincial only |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Mon) | |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Mon) | |
| **Remembrance Day** (observed in some provinces) | Nov 10 | Monday | **Nov 10–12** (Mon‑Wed) | Observed on Monday, Nov 10 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23–25** (Sat‑Mon) | |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 | Tuesday | — | Observed on Wednesday, Dec 27 – no long weekend |

### How to use this list

1. **Identify the weekend** that surrounds the holiday (Saturday–Sunday–Monday).  
2. **Add the holiday** itself if it falls on a Friday or Monday.  
3. **Count the days**:  
   * If the holiday is on a Friday → 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun).  
   * If on a Monday → 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon).  
   * If on a Saturday or Sunday → 2‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun or Sun‑Mon).  

### Provincial variations

| Province | Extra long‑weekend holidays (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|----------|-----------------------------------|-------------------|
| **Alberta** | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) | Mar 17–19 (Mon‑Wed) |
| **British Columbia** | St. Pat’s Day (Mar 17) | Mar 17–19 (Mon‑Wed) |
| **Manitoba** | St. Pat’s Day (Mar 17) | Mar 17–19 (Mon‑Wed) |
| **New Brunswick** | St. Pat’s Day (Mar 17) | Mar 17–19 (Mon‑Wed) |
| **Ontario** | Family Day (Feb 20) | Feb 18–20 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Quebec** | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day (Jun 24) | Jun 24–26 (Mon‑Wed) |
| **Saskatchewan** | St. Pat’s Day (Mar 17) | Mar 17–19 (Mon‑Wed) |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | St. Pat’s Day (Mar 17) | Mar 17–19 (Mon‑Wed) |
| **Prince Edward Island** | St. Pat’s Day (Mar 17) | Mar 17–19 (Mon‑Wed) |

> **Tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you can store the above dates in a database and flag the “long‑weekend” flag for each holiday. Then, when a user selects a province, filter the list accordingly.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of provincial holidays for a specific province or if you need the data in a particular format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
